transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in today?

Ever since the car accident last week, I keep reliving it over and over in my head, even when I’m trying to work or relax, and I can’t seem to shut it off. It just feels like my brain keeps hitting replay on those terrifying moments, and I don't know how to make it stop.

Since the accident, have you also had nightmares, flashbacks, or been avoiding reminders of the crash, like driving or talking about it? And have these symptoms been getting better, or have they lasted more than a month?

Yes, it feels like a constant replay where my body clamps up like I'm back in that moment, and I'm actively avoiding driving or even talking about road trips. The crash only happened six days ago, so it hasn't been a month, but these feelings haven't let up at all.
Since the accident, have you had moments where you felt numb, detached, or like things around you were unreal, or like you were watching the event happen from outside your body?

Yes, I keep getting this weird, floaty feeling where my living room and the campus hallways look far away and unreal, almost like I'm watching myself from over my own shoulder. I also feel completely flat and disconnected, and I can't seem to feel any of the warmth or joy I normally would when my family reaches out to me.
Since the accident, have you had trouble remembering important parts of what happened, or do you feel detached from yourself or like the world around you is unreal most of the time?

No, I don't have any trouble remembering the accident—if anything, I remember it all too clearly. But I definitely get that weird, floaty feeling several times a day where my living room or the campus hallways look far away and completely unreal. It really feels like I'm watching myself move and talk from just over my shoulder instead of actually being in my own body.

Have these symptoms been improving at all, or are they still just as intense since the accident? Also, have you had any periods of complete emotional numbness or being unable to respond to people around you?

No, they haven't improved at all; they've been nonstop and just as intense for the past six days since the crash. I feel this constant emotional flatness and disconnection, where I can't access any joy or warmth when my husband or niece reaches out to me. During those moments, I just feel completely numb and floaty, as if I'm watching myself from the outside and my surroundings aren't even real.
Have these symptoms lasted for less than one month since the accident, or have they continued for longer than a month?
They have definitely lasted for less than a month, since the accident only happened last week. I've been experiencing these reactions nonstop for the past six days.
Have your symptoms been getting better at all, or are they still just as intense and constant as they were right after the accident?

No, they haven't gotten better at all; they are still just as intense and constant as they were right after the crash. It has been happening nonstop for the past six days, and I feel completely exhausted because there is just no break from it.
